svg.title: Happy birthday, Trap — Arcade's graffiti mural
svg.desc: 140 approved hand-painted covers by 140 people. Each painting includes its original birthday wish in its description.
svg.metadata: Snapshot 8293ad0adab0fd5a. Saved 2026-11-10T14:24:38.001Z. Original vector strokes; no external assets.

g.title: MADIIROSE
g.desc: Happy birthday Trap!🎂✨ May this next year be filled with happiness and joy. I wish you to receive all that your heart desires. Thank you for all that you do! May God bless you always❤️

g.title: Pengux
g.desc:
🎂💗 Happiest Birthday Trap 💗✨
Wishing you a day filled with endless happiness, beautiful memories, laughter and all the little things that make life special May this new chapter bring you countless blessings, success, and everything your heart wishes for 🌸 A special thank you for always being there for your constant support and for being such a wonderful presence in our Arcade GC Your kindness, encouragement and willingness to stand by everyone never go unnoticed People like you make a community feel more like a family and we're genuinely grateful to have you around ❤️

g.title: Blsm
g.desc: Wishing you a very HAPPY BIRTHDAY, have a GREAT DAY! 🎂

g.title: JadugarX
g.desc: Happy birthday to trap enjoy your day may god bless you 💞
